subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding retirement accounts at a basic level and why saving for retirement starts well before retirement age
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the compound growth concept from P6 — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares simulated retirement savings started at different ages and observes the ending totals
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an earlier retirement contribution start age to its larger ending balance
exercise.abstract: Student explains why starting to save for retirement earlier in life makes a large difference by retirement age

misconception_flags: believes retirement savings can be effectively 'caught up' just as easily starting later in life

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
